prerequisites: Basic knowledge of manufacturing processes, capabilities and their field of application.
Advanced knowledge of design using CAD tools, execution and interpretation of manufacturing drawings.
Knowledge of prototype design and manufacturing acquired in the second semester of the master's degree.

learning_outcomes.text: Prepare technical specifications that allow to pose a problem in mechatronics engineering maintaining a global and integrative vision and using prescriptive, procedural or performance specifications as appropriate.
Organize conceptual design activity to support decision-making and selection among possible solutions to an engineering problem.

Evaluate the viability of new mechatronic products, based on their technological characteristics, manufacturing possibilities and other socio-economic factors related to their possible implementation.

That students know how to apply the acquired knowledge and their problem-solving capacity in new or little-known environments within broader (or multidisciplinary) contexts related to their area of study

That students are able to integrate knowledge and face the complexity of formulating judgments from information that, being incomplete or limited, includes reflections on the social and ethical responsibilities linked to the application of their knowledge and judgments
That students know how to communicate their conclusions and the knowledge and ultimate reasons that support them to specialized and non-specialized audiences in a clear and unambiguous way
That students possess learning skills that allow them to continue studying in a largely self-directed or autonomous way.

Know and use finite element simulation software to study the integral behavior (mechanical, static and dynamic, thermal, magnetic, electrical, etc.) of mechatronic elements and correctly interpret the results.
Select the material, dimension and optimize the shape of the elements of mechatronic systems, taking into account criteria of resistance, durability and reliability.
Plan the manufacturing processes of the components of a mechatronic system taking into account the restrictions imposed by the manufacturing, assembly and verification environment.
Plan the assembly, commissioning and maintenance of a mechatronic equipment or system.
Identify the subcomponents of a technologically complex system, the interactions between them, and the effects and consequences of their possible redesign.
Know the regulations and apply quality management techniques and tools in the design of mechatronic equipment and systems.
Acquire knowledge, techniques and skills, which represent an increase in research and innovation potential and promote technology transfer to industry
Know and apply the main aspects that affect decisions regarding the manufacturing of mass-produced products.
Know and apply the design conditions for parts and the development of specific tooling for the main mass production processes.
Know the main techniques and technologies for automated handling and assembly.
Know and apply dimensional control techniques in the different stages of product manufacturing (from component manufacturing to final verification).
Know the flow and control of documents that certify product manufacturing to guarantee traceability.

syllabus_topics: Engineering for manufacturing cast metal, plastic, and sheet metal products
In-process and final product dimensional and geometric control
Integration of in-process dimensional and geometric control

assessment_methods.method: Involvement in the development of the course

assessment_rules: To pass the course, the overall score obtained must be equal to or greater than 50% of the maximum possible score. This evaluation system applies to all ordinary and extraordinary calls. For differentiated evaluation, the written test of theoretical knowledge accounts for 50%, and work and projects account for 50%. The written test for differentiated evaluation will consist of two parts, with 70% related to expository classes and classroom practices, and 30% to laboratory practices.
